title: Page 5
content_zh:
想到温希琳自小就有个坏习惯——即使再饿她也不会喊一声，如果被母亲遗忘了，她也会跟着遗忘自己，他从以前就厌恶她这样的恶习，不会照顾自己，也不懂得争取。

“你今天吃了什么？或者我该问你昨天有没有吃东西？”文景瑞咄咄逼人的问。

本想说她有吃，可在文景瑞警告的眼神下，温希琳只能老实地回答，“我没胃口……”

“没胃口也要吃。”文景瑞嘱咐从马厩赶来，负责照顾时光的教练带走马儿后，便拎着虚弱得快要倒下的温希琳往俱乐部主塔走去。

温希琳小他四岁，今年也有二十八岁了，一个二十八岁的女人怎么重量感觉跟她十几岁的时候没有什么分别？

她到底在搞什么？都这么大了还是不会照顾自己吗？

“你在搞什么？几岁的人了还不知道要爱惜自己。”文景瑞忍不住数落她。

“我……”温希琳想为自己辩解，可她头好晕、好不舒服，嘴一张，又吐了。

这一回没能来得及转身吐在角落，而是直接以喷泉般的姿态，将酸水吐到文景瑞精致干净的马术装上头。

“对、对不起……呕……”越紧张，胃中冒出的酸水越是止不住，温希琳吐得一发不可收拾，不只吐了他一身，连自己身上也沾染了不少。

文景瑞阴沉着脸等她吐完，等到她再也没有继续吐的迹象后，他才静静地开了口，“跟我到房间打理一下你自己，然后我们再坐下来好好谈。”

第2章(2)

温希琳不曾来过马场俱乐部的会员房间，应该说，这间俱乐部她也是第一次来。

被文景瑞带到私人的专属房间，被嘱咐进浴室打理自己，她万分抱歉地看着狼狈程度不下于她的文景瑞，表示她可以等他先清理。

“不要让我说第二次，去、洗、澡，你又臭又脏。”

对欸，她不只没有吃东西，也没有洗澡，真的很脏，方才又吐了一身，温希琳想想也是，就进了浴室。

她不用烦恼换洗衣物，俱乐部的人会送来合她尺寸的衣服、鞋子，从里到外一应俱全。

就在她整理好自己，干净清爽地离开浴室来到房间内时，文景瑞已脱下马术装，换上一身优雅休闲服，坐在摆满食物的桌子前低头凝视手中的文件。

温希琳心一热，想着她的景瑞哥哥真的没变，满桌子的食物一看就知道都是为了她而准备的。

察觉到房间内的异样，文景瑞抬起头一看，看见打理干净但仍难掩虚弱的她，眉头一皱，声音低沉道：“坐下来，吃东西。”

温希琳听话地坐下来，拿起刀叉，吃起面前那一盘意大利面。

面很好吃，是她吃过最好吃的意大利面，而文景瑞一边看着手中的文件，一边还分菜到她面前的盘子里，肉、鱼、色拉，低声吩咐要她吃完，就跟小时候一样，用心照顾着她。

“景瑞哥哥，我没想到会再见到你，也很高兴……你没有变。”温希琳笑着说。

他爱护她的心情没变，对她依然是那么温柔。

“我没变？”文景瑞觉得好笑，放下手中的数据。“若我没有变，怎么爬到今天的地位？你从哪一点看出来我没有变，就因为我盯着你吃饭，你就以为我还跟以前一样？温希琳，你未免想太多，我不过是不想看到有人昏倒在我眼前，而且我这样是在确保我的权利。”

他早就变了，变得高壮结实，变得有权有势，他的成就让他能够成为这间俱乐部的会员，还拥有一匹很美丽的马儿，如果是以前的他，绝对不可能有今天的成绩。

温希琳呆了呆，笑容僵在脸上。

她突然对眼前这个男人感到陌生，他的五官没了少年时期的青涩，而是转为成年男子的成熟睿智，可他也变得更为尖锐，跟青少年时期的粗暴完全不同。

温希琳明白，他们的父母带给彼此巨大的伤害，伤口永远都无法愈合，可她所熟悉的景瑞哥哥不是现在这样的，不是！

“权利？什么你的权利？”温希琳捕捉到他话中的怪异之处，忍不住问。

文景瑞勾唇一笑，那笑容让她全身发毛，而他接下来说的话更是让她的脸色在一瞬间惨白。

“温希恩，十四岁，你同父异母的妹妹，三天前在体操比赛中心脏病发，休克送医，至今仍未清醒，积欠医药费用高达……”文景瑞精确地说出了温希恩就医所积欠的费用，更点出了温希琳跟她的关系。

他是怎么知道的？她明明没说……是了，方才在她打理自己时，他一定已经调查过自己了，关于她和希恩的数据很快就被送到他手上，这样的快速，这样的权势莫名的令温希琳感到害怕不安。

这个男人已经不是她所熟悉的大哥哥了。

“我的权利正是你的身体，我要你有健康的身体，好生下健康的小孩，盯你吃东西不是因为以前的情分，而是因为在商言商。”文景瑞笑着，心想她怎么还是这么天真？

“我们会有合法的婚姻关系，直到你生下小孩为止，若你离婚后要见小孩我不反对，但得用我同意的方式跟我的小孩接触，明白吗？”他的神情很柔和，可语调却是冰冷的，没有半点温度，而且也不给她任何反驳、拒绝的机会。

“方才我都看见了，你外公对你仍是不理不睬，连话都不愿听你说，而你母亲在四年前再婚，嫁给了一个法国人，目前下落不明，上回出现是一年前，地点在希腊，恐怕一时半会是找不到她了，现在你妹妹快要死了，只有我愿意出钱救她，我想在这个时候，你没有选择的余地。”

温雅这个无缘的继母还是一样啊，有了男人和爱情就把女儿丢下，不管不顾，这才叫没有变呢，真不知道那女人当时硬把小孩留在自己身边到底有什么意义。文景瑞讥诮的想着。

母亲指望不上，外公见死不救，他现在是她唯一的救星，说他趁人之危也好，没有同情心也罢，只要能达到目的就行。

温希琳愣愣的看着他，文景瑞从头到尾都挂着如沐春风的笑容，但她笑不出来，眼神显露哀伤、痛苦。

她一直以为自己长大了，不再是寄人篱下的小孩，她有一份收入不错的工作，认识的人都不知道她真正的背景，让她很自在。

可如今在一个知道她身世，知道她不受家人欢迎，知道她所有恐惧、伤心的人面前，她觉得自己又变成了那个没有行为能力，只能依附着母亲的任性和霸道，才能拥有栖身之地的小女孩。

温雅在十七岁那年生下温希琳，却不知道她的爸爸是谁，这对当时的温家造成了非常大的冲击。

温祖雄有很多老婆，生下的清一色都是男孩，而温雅是原配所出，也是同辈中唯一的女生，加上是老来得女，自然疼爱非常，所以对于最疼爱的女儿未婚怀孕一事，他十分震怒，急于想抹去这不名誉的污点，本来温希琳应该是生下来就要被送走的，但温雅却坚持要将她留在身边。

为了留下她，温雅跟温祖雄达成了协议，接下来的人生她都必须听从父亲的安排，好好念书，当个称职的温家千金。

而温希琳自小是在佣人房长大，从小到大能见到自己母亲的机会少之又少，外公看见她就不开心，从来不正眼瞧她，虽然是自己的亲人，可她从来没有享受过亲情，也不知道家庭温暖是什么感觉，直到母亲结婚了，她被带过去跟继父一同生活，但是那个地方也不能叫做家……
content_en:
Thinking of Wen Xilin's bad habit since she was a child - she would not cry out even if she was hungry, and if her mother forgot, she would also forget herself. He had always hated her for such bad habits, not knowing how to take care of herself, and not knowing how to fight for herself.

"What did you eat today? Or should I ask you if you had anything to eat yesterday?" Wen Jingrui asked aggressively.

She wanted to say that she had eaten, but under Wen Jingrui's warning eyes, Wen Xilin could only answer honestly, "I have no appetite..."

"You have to eat even if you don't have an appetite." Wen Jingrui asked the coach who came from the stable and was responsible for taking care of the time. After taking the horse away, he carried Wen Xilin, who was so weak that she was about to collapse, to the main tower of the club.

Wen Xilin is four years younger than him, and she is twenty-eight years old this year. How can a twenty-eight-year-old woman feel that her weight is no different from when she was a teenager?

What on earth is she doing?Even at this age, you still don’t know how to take care of yourself?

"What are you doing? How old are you and you still don't know how to cherish yourself?" Wen Jingrui couldn't help scolding her.

"I..." Wen Xilin wanted to defend herself, but she felt dizzy and uncomfortable. She opened her mouth and vomited again.

This time, he didn't have time to turn around and vomit in the corner. Instead, he directly spat the acidic water onto Wen Jingrui's exquisite and clean equestrian clothing in a fountain-like manner.

"Yes, I'm sorry... vomit..." The more nervous she became, the more acidic water emerged from her stomach. Wen Xilin vomited out of control. Not only did she vomit all over him, but she also got a lot of it on herself.

Wen Jingrui waited gloomily for her to finish vomiting. When she showed no signs of vomiting anymore, he spoke quietly, "Come to the room with me and take care of yourself, and then we can sit down and talk."

Chapter 2(2)

Wen Xilin had never been to the members' room of the racecourse club. It should be said that this was her first time in this club.

Wen Jingrui was taken to a private room and told to go into the bathroom to take care of herself. She looked at Wen Jingrui who was no less embarrassed than her with extreme regret and said she could wait for him to clean up first.

"Don't let me tell you a second time, go take a shower, you're smelly and dirty."

By the way, not only had she not eaten, nor had she taken a shower, she was really dirty, and she had just vomited all over her body again. Wen Xilin thought about it and entered the bathroom.

She doesn't have to worry about changing clothes. People at the club will bring her clothes and shoes that fit her size, both inside and out.

Just when she tidied herself up and left the bathroom cleanly and came to the room, Wen Jingrui had taken off his equestrian clothes and put on elegant casual clothes. He sat in front of a table full of food and stared down at the documents in his hands.

Wen Xilin's heart warmed, thinking that her brother Jingrui had really not changed. One look at the food on the table showed that it was all prepared for her.

Sensing something strange in the room, Wen Jingrui raised his head and saw that she was clean but still weak. He frowned and said in a low voice: "Sit down and eat."

Wen Xilin sat down obediently, picked up the knife and fork, and ate the plate of spaghetti in front of her.

The noodles were delicious, the best pasta she had ever tasted. While looking at the documents in his hands, Wen Jingrui put the meat, fish, and salad on the plate in front of her, and whispered to her to finish them. He took good care of her just like he did when he was a child.

"Brother Jingrui, I didn't expect to see you again, and I'm very happy... you haven't changed." Wen Xilin said with a smile.

His love and care for her has not changed, and he is still so gentle towards her.

"I haven't changed?" Wen Jingrui felt funny and put down the data in his hand."If I haven't changed, how did I get to where I am today? From what point do you see that I haven't changed? Just because I stare at you eating, do you think I am still the same as before? Wen Xilin, you are thinking too much. I just don't want to see someone faint in front of me, and I am ensuring my rights by doing this."

He has changed a long time ago, becoming taller, stronger, and more powerful. His achievements have allowed him to become a member of this club and own a very beautiful horse. If he had been before, he would never have achieved what he has today.

Wen Xilin was stunned, with a smile on her face.

She suddenly felt unfamiliar with the man in front of her. His facial features had lost the youthfulness of his youth, and had transformed into the maturity and wisdom of an adult man. However, he had also become sharper, completely different from the roughness of his youth.

Wen Xilin understands that their parents have caused great harm to each other, and the wounds will never heal, but the brother Jingrui she is familiar with is not like this, no!

"Rights? What are your rights?" Wen Xilin caught the weirdness in his words and couldn't help but ask.

Wen Jingrui curled up his lips and smiled, that smile made her whole body tremble, and what he said next made her face turn pale in an instant.

"Wen Xien, fourteen years old, your half-sister, suffered a heart attack during a gymnastics competition three days ago. She went into shock and was taken to the hospital. She is still awake and owes as much as..." Wen Jingrui accurately stated the accumulated medical expenses for Wen Xien, and also pointed out the relationship between Wen Xilin and her.

How did he know?She clearly didn't say... Yes, when she was taking care of herself, he must have already investigated her. The data about her and Xian was quickly sent to him. Such speed and power made Wen Xilin feel inexplicably scared and uneasy.

This man is no longer the big brother she is familiar with.

"My right is your body. I want you to have a healthy body so that you can give birth to healthy children. I watch you eating not because of our previous friendship, but because we are doing business." Wen Jingrui smiled, thinking why is she still so naive?

"We will have a legal marriage until you give birth to a child. If you want to see the child after the divorce, I have no objection, but you must contact my child in a way that I agree with. Do you understand?" His expression was very soft, but his tone was cold, without any warmth, and he did not give her any chance to refute or refuse.

"I saw everything just now. Your grandpa is still ignoring you and doesn't even want to listen to what you say. Your mother remarried four years ago to a Frenchman. Her current whereabouts are unknown. The last time she appeared was a year ago in Greece. I'm afraid she won't be found for a while. Now your sister is about to die. I am the only one willing to pay to save her. I think at this time, you have no choice."

Wen Ya, the unfavorable stepmother, is still the same. When she has a man and love, she abandons her daughter and doesn't care. This is called unchanged. I really don't know what the point of that woman forcing the child to stay with her at that time.Wen Jingrui thought sarcastically.

Her mother couldn't count on her, and her grandfather refused to save her. He was now her only savior. It didn't matter whether he took advantage of others' danger or had no sympathy, as long as he could achieve his goal.

Wen Xilin looked at him blankly. Wen Jingrui had a spring-like smile from beginning to end, but she couldn't smile, and her eyes showed sadness and pain.

She always thought that she had grown up and was no longer a dependent child. She had a well-paying job and no one she knew knew her true background, which made her very comfortable.

But now, in front of a person who knows her life experience, knows that she is not welcomed by her family, and knows all her fears and sadness, she feels that she has become the little girl who has no ability to act and can only rely on her mother's willfulness and domineering to have a roof over her head.

Wen Ya gave birth to Wen Xilin when she was seventeen, but she didn't know who her father was. This had a huge impact on the Wen family at the time.

Wen Zuxiong had many wives, and all of his children were boys. Wen Ya was the daughter of his original wife and the only girl of his generation. Plus, he was a daughter of old age, so he loved her very much. Therefore, he was very angry about the pregnancy of his most beloved daughter out of wedlock, and was eager to erase this dishonorable stain. Wen Xilin should have been sent away after she was born, but Wen Ya insisted on keeping her by his side.

In order to keep her, Wen Ya reached an agreement with Wen Zuxiong. She must obey her father's arrangements for the rest of her life, study hard, and be a competent daughter of the Wen family.

And Wen Xilin grew up in a servant's room. She had very few opportunities to see her mother. Her grandfather was unhappy when he saw her and never looked at her. Although she was a relative of hers, she had never enjoyed family affection and did not know what the warmth of family felt like. It was not until her mother got married that she was taken to live with her stepfather, but that place could not be called home...
